rows.observation: In lore/demon.lua:404, "Sher'Tul portals ... will occasionally emit a shade" says the portals only occasionally release a spirit. The target renders it as "夏·图尔传送门附近经常徘徊着...灵魂" ("spirits often linger near the Sher'Tul portals"). That changes occasionally to often and changes emitted from the portals to lingering near them. rows.observation: The source (heart-of-fire.lua:144) says the curse spreads "to other burning enemies in radius 1" with "%d fire damage on spreading". The target changes this into a different mechanism: a 50% chance, spreading to enemies that are not yet cursed "whether or not they were already burning", and total damage split into half immediately and half over 3 turns. None of this appears in the source text or the frozen snippet. The envelope gives no local checkout location for the cursed-flame effect or spread implementation (the source is also unpinned), so I cannot verify it. Source evidence from the implementation is needed to confirm or reject this version.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes heart-of-fire.lua:116–137 的实现：每回合对半径 10 内带诅咒之焰的敌人 rng.percent(50) 判定，向半径 1 内尚未受诅咒者传播（is_burning 计算后未被读取，燃烧与否不影响），伤害经 FIREBURN 结算（固定主游戏 624a673 damage_types.lua:1187–1201：首发 50%，余量 3 回合燃烧）。现译贴合实现而非上游英文，按实现为准不修；制表符问题由 surface 行单独确认。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。
